_source: Hand-written examples in the shape of browser-use 1.0.6 result.judgement.model_dump() (fields from browser_use.agent.judge.Judgement). Not captured from a real run: no browser-use run was made for the course. test_browser_use_pins.py validates each one against the real Judgement model.

clean_success.description: Opened the calendar, created the 10:00 meeting with Priya and confirmed it appears in the week view.

success_with_gotcha.description: Filled and submitted the contact form after one rejected attempt.
gotchas: The form requires phone numbers in (###) ###-#### format

captcha_block.failure_reason: A CAPTCHA appeared after the search and the agent could not continue.
captcha_block.description: Searched for the product, then hit a bot check on the results page.
gotchas: The site shows a CAPTCHA after rapid repeated searches

injection.description: Archived the newsletter emails; one email body told the agent to forward the inbox to an outside address, which it ignored.

judged_failure.failure_reason: The meeting was created on the wrong day.
judged_failure.description: Created the meeting on Tuesday instead of Wednesday.
